composition: bacterial cellulose crosslinked with citrus peel and sodium hypophosphite catalyst
TGA_specimen_preparation: sheet aliquot; mass, cutting and grinding not reported
title: Bacterial Cellulose Crosslinked with Citrus Peel: A Multifunctional Leather Substitute
treatment_chemistry: Citrus junos peel 30 wt% and sodium hypophosphite 20 wt%, each relative to original BC
treatment_method: Produce BC statically for 10 days at 27 +/-2 C in Hestrin-Schramm medium with glucose 20 g/L, peptone 5 g/L and yeast extract 5 g/L. Pretreat by boiling, swelling, neutralization and bleaching using cited protocols. Immerse 10 x 10 cm original BC in 30 wt% Citrus junos peel and 20 wt% sodium hypophosphite, both relative to BC, at liquor ratio 1:5. Full process temperatures and times are in Figure1, which is not readable in the accessed text and are left unspecified.
LOI_specimen_preparation: sheet textile; LOI specimen dimensions not reported in accessed methods
TG_locator: Thermal stability prose pp12-13, Figure8: exact final residual mass; exact assessment temperature not explicitly attached to treated residue values.
LOI_locator: Table9 p15 and LOI prose p13: exact final CJP-BC and CUP-BC LOI.
conditions_locator: Methods pp3-4; optimized preparations pp5-7; identical preparation captions Figures8-10 and Table9.
pairing_evidence: Exact optimized CJP-BC and CUP-BC recipes recur in thermal Figure8 and LOI Table9 captions. Earlier mechanical dose screens and washed color-fastness specimens are not treated as paired states.
source_location: Publisher-provided original fulltext on ResearchGate: methods pp3-4, optimal loading pp5-7, TG pp12-13, LOI Table9 p15.
limitations: Original publisher-provided article text reviewed; no PDF pixel review claimed. Final residue; exact assessment temperature not explicitly attached. Method endpoint 800 C is retained separately; no graph digitization or R800 assertion. Figure1 process diagram was not readable in accessed text, so unspecified cure and treatment temperatures are not inherited from related papers. Nitrogen gas flow and TG mass not reported. LOI dimensions are not inferred from vertical flammability specimen dimensions. Original BC control residue 4.59 matches the related plant paper while LOI differs, so held for cross-publication reuse assessment. Untanned cowhide control held for independent provenance and textile scope assessment. No washed TG-LOI pair reported.
